# RigViewer

> Zero-setup viewer for [RigWorks](https://github.com/rigkid/RigWorks) documents — JSON in, scene out (web Three.js + optional RigKit desktop).

**Viewer presents; Player plays.** RigViewer does not execute document Lua.

## AI entry

1. Load RigWorks skill first: [generating-rig-documents](https://github.com/rigkid/RigWorks/blob/main/skills/generating-rig-documents/SKILL.md) — emit POD JSON, validate, do not invent schema ids.
2. Check what this viewer actually draws: [docs/port-map.md](docs/port-map.md). Sketches → Viewer URL; playable documents → RigPlayer (`.rig`).
3. Prefer patterns from [examples/](examples/) (`minimal-scene.json`, `demo-3d.json`, `demo-gleditor.json`, `lfo-binding.json`, `ui-panel.json`).
4. Preview: open the hosted viewer with a reachable document URL, or paste locally.

## Preview URLs

```
https://viewer.rigs.works/?src=/examples/demo-3d.json
https://viewer.rigs.works/web/?src=/examples/demo-3d.json
https://viewer.rigs.works/?src=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<org>/<repo>/<ref>/path/doc.json
https://viewer.rigs.works/?doc=u1.<base64url>   # small sketches only (see docs/ai-share.md)
https://viewer.rigs.works/?local=1              # restore browser-local save
```

Hosted site serves the viewer at `/` and mirrors it under `/web/` (local `npm run serve` uses `/web/`).

Share ladder (doc → warn → src/local): [docs/ai-share.md](docs/ai-share.md).

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md) — run web / desktop
- [docs/port-map.md](docs/port-map.md) — supported schema ids (web vs desktop)
- [docs/ai-share.md](docs/ai-share.md) — generate → validate → open URL
- [desktop/README.md](desktop/README.md) — RigKit host build
- [docs/api/Doxyfile](docs/api/Doxyfile) — optional Doxygen over desktop headers

## Tools

- `npm test` — parser smoke over `examples/`
- `npm run check` — test + single-file bundle
- `npm run serve` — local static server (port fallback if 8765 busy)
- RigWorks `tools/rig-validate` — validate before claiming a document is good
